Buscamos desenvolvedores Java sólidos que escrevam código excelente, pensem em sistemas e adotem o desenvolvimento assistido por IA como parte central do seu fluxo de trabalho.Propósito do Cargo ComoSenior Java Developer, você vai construir e manter serviços backend e módulos de plataforma que suportam operações críticas de negócio. Você não precisa de experiência prévia no domínio financeiro — nós ensinamos. O que precisamos é de um desenvolvedor que escreva Java limpo e performante, domine padrões de design, entenda sistemas distribuídos e use ferramentas como Claude Code para se mover rápido sem sacrificar qualidade.Responsabilidades Principais: Desenvolvimento Backend Projetar, construir e manter serviços backend em Java 8+/Spring Boot: APIs REST, jobs de processamento batch, pipelines de transformação de dados e camadas de integração. Escrever código limpo, bem testado e pronto para produção, aplicando princípios SOLID, padrões de design (Strategy, Factory, Observer, Builder, Template Method, entre outros) e as diretrizes arquiteturais da equipe. Ser dono de features end-to-end: desde o design técnico até a implementação, testes, code review e deploy em produção. Otimizar o desempenho de aplicações: identificar e resolver gargalos em queries, chamadas a serviços, uso de memória e throughput. Aplicar corretamente padrões de concorrência e gerenciamento de threads em Java para operações paralelas e assíncronas.Design e Arquitetura Participar de decisões de design de software: seleção de padrões, definição de contratos entre componentes, separação de responsabilidades e modelagem de domínios. Aplicar princípios de design orientado a objetos (encapsulamento, herança, composição, polimorfismo) e design por contrato na construção de módulos. Contribuir para o design de arquiteturas limpas: separação de camadas (controller, service, repository), injeção de dependências, inversão de controle e baixo acoplamento entre módulos. Avaliar trade-offs técnicos entre diferentes abordagens de design, documentando decisões e suas justificativas.Banco de Dados e Integrações Trabalhar com Oracle Database: escrever e otimizar consultas SQL, stored procedures e packages PL/SQL para operações intensivas em dados. Construir e manter integrações com sistemas externos via APIs REST, cobrindo ingestão, transformação e sincronização de dados. Projetar padrões de acesso a dados eficientes usando JPA/Hibernate ou JDBC, com atenção a gerenciamento de conexões, cache de entidades e limites transacionais. Implementar estratégias de resiliência em integrações: retentativas, circuit breakers, timeouts e tratamento gracioso de falhas.Infraestrutura e Deploy Implantar e gerenciar aplicações em Kubernetes (OKE) com contêineres Docker e servidor de aplicações WebLogic. Trabalhar com pipelines CI/CD (GitLab CI ou similar) para fluxos automatizados de build, teste e deployment. Diagnosticar problemas em produção: analisar logs, métricas de aplicação e comportamento do sistema para resolver incidentes.Desenvolvimento Assistido por IA Usar Claude Code como ferramenta principal de desenvolvimento: geração de código, refatoração, debugging, escrita de testes e exploração de codebases desconhecidos. Escrever e manter documentação técnica em Markdown que sirva como contexto de alta qualidade tanto para ferramentas de IA quanto para a equipe. Aplicar habilidades de engenharia de prompts: decompor problemas complexos em prompts claros e acionáveis, avaliando criticamente as saídas geradas por IA. Contribuir para as práticas de desenvolvimento com IA da equipe: compartilhar padrões eficazes, identificar limitações e ajudar a estabelecer melhores práticas.Colaboração e Crescimento Participar de revisões de código com feedback construtivo e rigoroso, focado em corretude, legibilidade, padrões e manutenibilidade. Mentorar desenvolvedores junior através de pair programming, discussões de design e transferência de conhecimento. Contribuir para discussões técnicas sobre arquitetura, ferramentas e melhorias de processos.Requisitos Obrigatórios: Graduação em Ciência da Computação, Engenharia de Software ou áreas correlatas. 5+ anos de experiência profissional em desenvolvimento Java. Domínio sólido de Java 8+ (streams, lambdas, concorrência, collections, Optional, API de data/hora) e Spring Boot 2.7+ (injeção de dependências, REST controllers, segurança, Spring Data, testes). Conhecimento sólido de padrões de design GoF (criacionais, estruturais, comportamentais) e capacidade de aplicá-los corretamente conforme o contexto do problema. Domínio dos princípios SOLID, DRY, KISS e YAGNI na prática diária de desenvolvimento. Experiência com design orientado a objetos: modelagem de domínios, composição vs herança, encapsulamento, tratamento de exceções e design de APIs internas claras. Habilidades sólidas em SQL e bancos de dados relacionais: otimização de queries, estratégias de indexação, joins complexos, gerenciamento transacional. Experiência com Oracle é um diferencial forte. Experiência com estratégias de testes: testes unitários (JUnit, Mockito), testes de integração, test doubles e TDD ou BDD como prática habitual. Experiência com deploys em contêineres: Docker, Kubernetes (qualquer distribuição), pipelines CI/CD. Familiaridade com fluxos Git (Git Flow ou trunk-based), Postman/OpenAPI para desenvolvimento de APIs. Experiência prática com ferramentas de desenvolvimento assistido por IA — especialmente Claude Code. Esperamos que você use IA diariamente como multiplicador de produtividade, não como muleta. Comunicação escrita sólida: capacidade de produzir specs técnicos claros, documentos de design e descrições de PR.Requisitos Desejáveis: Experiência com Oracle PL/SQL: stored procedures, pipelined functions, performance tuning. Conhecimento de padrões de arquitetura: caching (Caffeine/Redis), arquitetura event-driven, design metadata-driven, CQRS. Experiência com arquiteturas de microsserviços ou modular monolith: estratégias de comunicação entre serviços, gerenciamento de transações distribuídas, contract testing. Familiaridade com Clean Architecture, Hexagonal Architecture ou Domain-Driven Design (DDD). Experiência com ferramentas de observabilidade: Grafana, Prometheus, métricas de aplicação, agregação de logs. Familiaridade com servidor de aplicações WebLogic ou runtimes Java empresariais similares. Experiência trabalhando em plataformas SaaS ou sistemas multi-tenant. Certificação Java (OCA/OCP) ou certificações técnicas equivalentes.O Que Valorizamos: Qualidade acima de velocidade:preferimos entregar código limpo e bem testado um dia depois do que debugar um desastre por uma semana. Fluência com IA:você vê Claude Code e ferramentas similares como partes essenciais do seu toolkit, não como novidades. Sabe quando confiar no output e quando questioná-lo. Critério de design:você não aplica padrões por inércia — sabe quando um Strategy simplifica e quando um if-else é suficiente. Prioriza clareza acima de cleverness. Pensamento sistêmico:considera os efeitos downstream das suas decisões de design em desempenho, manutenibilidade e velocidade da equipe. Ownership:leva suas features do design até produção e se importa com como seu código se comporta no mundo real. Curiosidade:se mantém atualizado com ferramentas e práticas de desenvolvimento, e tem interesse genuíno em evoluir no seu ofício. Comunicação clara:escreve documentação que seus colegas de equipe (e as ferramentas de IA) realmente conseguem usar.Processo de Candidatura: Candidatura:Candidate-se diretamente pelo LinkedIn. Teste técnico:Os candidatos selecionados receberão uma avaliação técnica online. Esta etapa é obrigatória e parte fundamental do processo. Entrevista com Líder e RH: Uma conversa com a equipe para te conhecer melhor e aprofundar sua experiência. Decisão:Informaremos o resultado com feedback, independentemente de você avançar ou não.Por que trabalhar na VMetrix NaVMetrix, não buscamos "fazer mais barulho", mas sim construir confiança em um mercado onde as decisões importam. Você terá a oportunidade de liderar uma função estratégica, com autonomia real, impacto direto no negócio e visibilidade executiva. Você fará parte de uma empresa que está redefinindo como as instituições financeiras adotam tecnologia crítica, em um ambiente desafiador, sofisticado e de alto nível profissional. Se você se motiva a construir marca, reputação e relações de longo prazo no coração do sistema financeiro, aVMetrixé o lugar.

Atua como suporte técnico estratégico às operações, assegurando a qualidade do serviço, conformidade com normas internacionais (API/ISO) e promovendo a melhoria contínua, contribuindo diretamente para a excelência operacional e resultados do negócio.ResponsabilidadesPlanejar, implementar e otimizar processos operacionais, garantindo qualidade na execução e cumprimento das metas organizacionais de forma eficiente e eficaz. Apoiar e, quando necessário, liderar investigações de falhas operacionais (eventos PC2 e PC3), conduzindo análise de causa raiz, garantindo documentação adequada e comunicação conforme fluxo estabelecido. Elaborar, revisar e padronizar instruções técnicas de trabalho (Work Instructions), procedimentos operacionais e demais documentos técnicos, assegurando aderência às políticas e requisitos corporativos. Atuar na gestão da qualidade e confiabilidade, por meio de análise de desempenho de processos, equipamentos e ativos, identificando tendências, desvios e riscos operacionais, e implementando ações preventivas e corretivas. Apoiar a gestão e desenvolvimento de fornecedores, garantindo alinhamento com requisitos técnicos, operacionais e de qualidade. Identificar e implementar oportunidades de melhoria contínua, utilizando metodologias estruturadas (Lean, Six Sigma, Kaizen, entre outras). Garantir o cumprimento das diretrizes de QHSE, promovendo uma cultura de segurança, qualidade e integridade operacional, incluindo suporte à gestão de treinamentos conforme matrizes internas e requisitos de clientes.RequisitosFormação superior em Engenharia (Mecânica, Produção, Petróleo ou áreas correlatas). Conhecimento em processos operacionais, melhoria contínua e análise de desempenho. Familiaridade com normas e padrões de qualidade (API Q1, API Q2, ISO 9001). Experiência com investigação de falhas e análise de causa raiz (RCA, 5 Porquês, Ishikawa) e metodologias de confiabilidade (FMEA, RCM, FRACAS ou similares). Conhecimento em ferramentas de melhoria contínua (Lean, Six Sigma, Kaizen, etc.) será considerado um diferencial. Inglês avançado (desejável, conforme interface com times globais). Habilidade analítica, com forte orientação para solução de problemas e melhoria de processos. Boa comunicação e capacidade de atuar em equipes multidisciplinares. Experiência prévia em confiabilidade e/ou formação específica na área será considerada um diferencial. Vivência em auditorias internas e/ou externas. Conhecimento nos softwares BlockSim e Weibull++ será considerado um diferencial.

title: Tech Agile Sênior
description:
DESCRIÇÃO DA VAGA:

Atuar como facilitador e agente de transformação ágil, promovendo a cultura de melhoria contínua e fortalecendo a colaboração entre os times. Seu papel será apoiar equipes multifuncionais na adoção e maturidade de práticas ágeis, além de impulsionar a eficiência dos processos e o alinhamento com os objetivos estratégicos da organização.

O QUE VOCÊ VAI FAZER:

  • Capacitar e treinar pessoas em ferramentas, métodos e processos ágeis, promovendo o conhecimento contínuo e a autonomia dos times;
  • Atuar como agente de mudança, questionando e provocando reflexões que fomentem o crescimento coletivo;
  • Praticar escutaativa, acolhendo e auxiliando nas questões individuais dos membros do time;
  • Apoiar as squads na construção de senso de pertencimento e na busca por alta performance;
  • Implementar práticas e ferramentas ágeis de acordo com o contexto e maturidade dos times;
  • Facilitar cerimônias ágeis, workshops de ideação, resolução de problemas e retrospectivas;
  • Gerenciar métricas relacionadas à eficiência dos processos e à saúde cultural dos times;
  • Estruturar processos de rotina e gestão do conhecimento para garantir a fluidez do trabalho;
  • Ajudar os timesna construção e condução de processos de experimentação e validação de hipóteses;
  • Identificar pontos de melhoria e gargalos no dia a dia das squads, atuando de forma colaborativa para solucioná-los;
  • Apoiar a estruturação e reorganização de tribos, promovendo sinergia entre as equipes;
  • Remover impedimentos e garantir que os times tenham um ambiente propício à entrega de valor.

O QUE ESPERAMOS DE VOCÊ:

  • Sólido conhecimento em metodologias ágeis (Scrum, Kanban, SAFe, Lean, XP);
  • Conhecimento emOKRs e práticas de gestão como Management 3.0;
  • Técnicas de facilitação e dinâmicas colaborativas;
  • Experiência em mapeamento, análise e melhoria de processos;
  • Familiaridade com ferramentas de acompanhamento ágil (Jira, Confluence, Miro, etc.);
  • Habilidade paraatuar com métricas de performance e cultura de times.

Requisitos desejáveis:

  • Certificações em metodologias ágeis (CSM, PSM, KMP, ICP-ATF, etc.);
  • Experiência como Agile Coach ou em ambientes com múltiplas squads;
  • Vivência com escalabilidade ágil (SAFe, LeSS, Spotify model);
  • Experiência em contextos de transformação digital e/ou cultural;
  • Conhecimento emcultura DevOps e Design Thinking.
  • Desejável atuação com diferentes perfis de equipes (tecnologia, produto, negócios) e em iniciativas de mudança cultural ou estrutural.

INFORMAÇÕES ADICIONAIS

Antes de mostrar nossos benefícios, deixa eu já te contar uma coisa: aqui as coisas acontecem em um ritmo acima da média.

A rotina em uma empresa de tecnologia é alucinante e o aprendizado é contínuo e diário. O melhor disso é que temos autonomia para colocar esse aprendizado em prática e buscar resultados.

E se errarmos? Voltamos e consertamos rápido, até criarmos aquilo que acreditamos ser parte da transformação de cada cliente.

Isso tudo acelera o nosso crescimento e nos torna a maior empresa de tecnologia do Brasil, ditando o ritmo do mercado nos mais diversos setores, fazendo tecnologia que transforma.

title: Customer Success Analyst
description:

title: Marketing Ai Agent Builder
description:
Role Overview:

As our Marketing AI Agent Builder, you will be the lead architect for our\ "agentic\" marketing stack. Your goal is to move beyond simple automation (if-this-then-that) toward autonomous systems that reason through marketing data, execute multi-channel campaigns, and self-correct based on performance. This is a\ "Builder\" role—part Engineer, part Strategist, part Data Scientist. This is a remote role with the option to work anywhere in NA.

Core Responsibilities:

- Intelligent Research & Segmentation: Deploy agents to crawl the web for intent signals (hiring changes, funding, news) to dynamically update ICP segments and enrich CRM records in real-time.

- Autonomous Campaign Management: Build agents that independently monitor live campaigns (Search, Social, Email) and autonomously reallocate budgets or pause underperforming creatives based on real-time ROI.

- Dynamic Lead Nurturing: Design agents that use Natural Language Processing (NLP) to\ "read\" prospect behavior andtrigger personalized, multi-step nurture sequences without manual intervention.

- Performance & Guardrails: Establish\ "human-in-the-loop\" protocols and evaluation frameworks to ensure agent outputs align with brand voice and security standards.

- System Orchestration: Connect AI agents to our core stack—including HubSpot/Salesforce, 6sense, and Google Analytics—ensuring seamless data flow and automated write-backs to the CRM.

Qualifications & Skills:

- Experience: 2–4 years in Growth Engineering, ideally with experience scaling a mid-market SaaS revenue engine.

- AI Tooling: Proficiency with agent orchestration frameworks (e.G., LangGraph, CrewAI) or low-code builder platforms (e.G., Claude CoWork, CodeX)

- Agent Orchestration: Experience with low-code/no-code platforms (e.G., Clay, Zapier Central, Make.Com) or code-based frameworks (e.G., LangGraph, CrewAI).

- Prompt Engineering: Ability to design complex\ "reasoning loops\" that prevent hallucinations and ensure professional, brand-aligned output.

- Data Savvy: Comfortable working with JSON, APIs, and RAG (Retrieval-Augmented Generation) to feed agents the right context from your company's internal knowledge base.

- Marketing Expertise: Knowledge of B2B buyer journeys, attribution models, and demand generation tactics.

title: Senior Business Analyst - Supply Chain
description:
Who We Are

We are an IFS integrator, providing end-to-end ERP implementation projects and exceptional support services. As strategic business partners, we collaborate with clients across key industries, helping them drive digital transformation.

Our global team of 200+ members brings extensive expertise, including former IFS customers who understand real-world operational challenges and dedicated IFS specialists with deep functional and technical knowledge. Together, we deliver outstanding services to reshape businesses and optimize supply chain operations.

Who We Are Looking For

We are currently seeking a Senior Business Analyst – Supply Chain, a client-facing leadership role responsible for driving complex ERP implementations within supply chain domains (procurement, inventory, logistics, planning, and distribution).

This role requires a strong functional expert who can lead requirement gathering, solution design, and implementation while acting as a key advisor to clients and an escalation point for junior analysts.

If you are passionate about supply chain optimization, ERP transformation, and leading cross-functional collaboration in global projects, we encourage you to apply.

Key Responsibilities

Business Requirements & Client Engagement

- Lead requirement gathering sessions with stakeholders across supply chain functions.

- Analyze business processes (procurement, inventory, warehousing, logistics) to identify improvements and optimization opportunities.

- Translate complex supply chain and technical concepts into clear language for non-technical stakeholders.

- Perform gap analysis between current operations and ERP capabilities, ensuring scalable and efficient solutions.

- Advise clients on best practices aligned with industry standards and digital transformation strategies.

Solution Design, Implementation & Testing

- Lead supply chain module implementation within ERP (IFS or similar).

- Supervise and mentor Business Analysts and Junior Analysts within the domain.

- Collaborate with Project Managers on planning, estimations, and risk mitigation.

- Work closely with development and technical teams to ensure accurate solution delivery.

- Lead design discussions to align system architecture with business objectives.

- Ensure quality assurance testing and validation of supply chain functionalities.

- Support cross-functional alignment with Solution Architects and other domains.

- Deliver user training sessions and create functional documentation to ensure adoption.

Training, Expertise & Continuous Improvement (20%)

- Act as a Subject Matter Expert (SME) in supply chain processes and ERP functionalities.

- Stay up to date with industry trends, including digital supply chain, automation, and best practices.

- Maintain relevant certifications (IFS or equivalent ERP modules).

- Drive continuous improvement initiatives across projects and internal practices.

Must Have

- Bachelor's degree in Supply Chain, Industrial Engineering, Business, or related field.

- Minimum 5 years of experience in supply chain processes (procurement, logistics, inventory, planning).

- Minimum 3 years in client-facing roles.

- Experience in ERP implementation projects (IFS preferred).

- Strong understanding of supply chain operations across industries such as Manufacturing, Energy, Construction, or Services.

- Fluent in Portuguese and English (Spanish or French is a plus).

- Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills.

- Strong analytical thinking and problem-solving capabilities.

- Experience with project management and collaboration tools.

- Advanced proficiency in Microsoft Office.

- Availability to travel.

- Legally authorized to work in Brazil.

What We Offer

- Competitive salary and benefits package.

- Career growth opportunities with certifications and professional development.

- A collaborative and international work environment.

- Involvement in high-impact global supply chain transformation projects.

Why Hoist?

If you are looking for an opportunity to lead impactful supply chain transformations and grow your career in a dynamic and global environment, Hoist is the place for you.

Join our team and be part of a people-first culture that values collaboration, innovation, and professional growth.

you will architect end-to-end intelligent systems that redefine how we handle financial data. You will be responsible for analyzing manual credit request processes and identifying opportunities to automate them using cutting-edge cloud AI services.

The ideal candidate bridges the gap between raw data and actionable business intelligence, building tools that ingest high-stakes data from credit agencies, analyze it through sophisticated AI pipelines, and present it via human-in-the-loop dashboards. You will work closely with engineering leadership to turn manual bottlenecks into scalable, automated cloud solutions.

Responsibilities

  • Process Architecture: Analyze existing credit request workflows to identify automation opportunities using cloud-native AI/ML solutions.
  • Intelligent Data Ingestion: Design and implement processes utilizing Document Intelligence (OCR/Form parsing), and Web Search integration to gather and structure fragmented data.
  • Third-Party Data Synthesis: Build tools to ingest and analyze complex results from credit agencies (e.G., D&B, Experian, Equifax ) to drive automated decision-making.
  • Custom Tooling: Develop custom software bridges to fill gaps between standard cloud AI services and specific business requirements.
  • Human-in-the-Loop Systems: Create intuitive dashboards that visualize AI-driven analysis, allowing human reviewers to audit and approve automated recommendations.
  • Cloud Deployment: Deploy and maintain robust MLOps pipelines in a cloud environment, ensuring high reliability and security for sensitive financial data.
  • Cross-Functional Collaboration: Communicate technical AI concepts to non-technical stakeholders and collaborate with backend teams to ensure seamless data flow.

Technology Requirements

  • 5+ years of experience in software engineering with a heavy focus on Cloud AI/ML implementations.
  • Cloud-First Expertise: Proven experience with Vertex AI (GCP), Azure AI, or AWS SageMaker, specifically utilizing high-level AI services (Document AI, Search/Discovery, etc.).
  • Data Integration: Proficiency in building API integrations and data pipelines that handle structured and unstructured data from external financial vendors.
  • Python Mastery: Expert-level Python skills, including experience with LangChain, LlamaIndex, or similar frameworks for building agentic AI workflows.
  • Visualization: Experience building data dashboards using tools like Streamlit, Looker, or custom React-based frontend components.
  • Security Mindset: Deep understanding of handling sensitive PII (Personally Identifiable Information) within cloud environments.

Profile Requirements

  • Solution Architect Mentality: Ability to look at a manual business process and map it to a technical AI roadmap.
  • Independent Problem Solver: A self-starter who can build\ "the bridge\" when a standardout-of-the-box tool doesn't exist.
  • Strong Communication: Ability to explain why an AI made a specific recommendation to stakeholders.
  • Agile Learner: A commitment to staying current with the rapid pace of LLM, RAG, and Agentic AI developments.
  • AI Tooling: Proficiency with AI-first engineering approaches and tooling is a plus. If you are familiar with the Cognition platform with Windsurf and Devin, that is even better.
  • Certifications: Google, Azure or AWS Cloud AI certifications are a big plus!

title: Product Owner - Sênior
description:
Product Owner - Sênior

A jornada de quem ama repensar o futuro está aqui.

Sobre a Rethink

Somos uma consultoria que une tecnologia, design e estratégia de produtos digitais para solucionar os desafios de grandes empresas brasileiras. Agora como parte da Framework Digital, ampliamos nosso impacto atuando de ponta a ponta na jornada digital, da concepção à escala.

Nossa missão é gerar valor real por meio de soluções que conectam times, sistemas e pessoas. Acreditamos que a transformação digital acontece quando estratégia, tecnologia e experiência andam juntas e é isso que entregamos.

Empresas como Smiles, Gol, Santander Esfera, Swift e Comgás confiam em nossa parceria para acelerar sua evolução digital com consistência e resultado.

Diversidade e Inclusão

Para repensar o futuro, é essencial garantir ambientes mais diversos e inclusivos. Por isso, incentivamos fortemente a candidatura de mulheres, pessoas pretas, pardas, indígenas, LGBTQIAPN+ e pessoas com deficiência .

Que tal repensar um futuro mais diverso com a gente?

Qual será o seu papel?

No seu dia a dia, você gerenciará o backlog do produto, priorizando funcionalidades com base no valor para o negócio, impacto operacional e necessidades regulatórias. Atuará como principal interlocutor entre as áreas de negócio (operações, comercial, regulatório, supply chain) e os times de desenvolvimento, traduzindo necessidades de negócio em requisitos técnicos claros e viáveis. Você liderará cerimônias ágeis e garantirá a entrega contínua de valor, promovendo melhorias incrementais nos processos de distribuição de gás. Além disso, acompanhará métricas de desempenho do produto (KPIs de negócio e de uso), proporá evoluções baseadas em dados e feedback dos usuários, e garantirá que as soluções desenvolvidas estejam em conformidade com as normas de segurança e regulação do setor de gás.

Como será seu dia a dia?

  • Gerenciar o backlog do produto, priorizando funcionalidades com base no valor para o negócio, impacto operacional e necessidades regulatórias.
  • Atuar como principal interlocutor(a) entre áreas de negócio (operações, comercial, regulatório e supply chain) e os times de desenvolvimento, traduzindo necessidades em requisitos técnicos claros e viáveis.
  • Liderar cerimônias ágeis e garantir a entrega contínua de valor para o produto.
  • Promover melhorias incrementais nos processos de distribuição de gás.
  • Acompanhar métricas de desempenho (KPIs de negócio e de uso), analisando dados para direcionar evoluções do produto.
  • Propor melhorias com base em dados e feedbacks dos usuários.
  • Garantir que as soluções estejam em conformidade com normas de segurança e regulação do setor.

Para esta vaga, é essencial:

  • Visão holística e estratégica, com capacidade de compreender o negócio de distribuição de gás de ponta a ponta, conectando iniciativas de tecnologia às metas do negócio.
  • Perfil de liderança com forte viés de execução, sendo "mão na massa", orientado(a) a resultados e capaz de remover impedimentos para garantir entregas com qualidade e agilidade.
  • Excelente comunicação e habilidade de transitar entre áreas, atuando como ponte entre negócio e tecnologia.
  • Sólido conhecimento em metodologias ágeis (Scrum, Kanban, SAFe) e práticas de gestão de produto (roadmaps, OKRs, MVPs).
  • Experiência na liderança de squads multidisciplinares e atuação em ciclos de discovery e delivery.
  • Formação superior em Administração, Engenharia, Ciência da Computação ou áreas correlatas.

Você pode se destacar se:

  • Possuir pós-graduação ou MBA em Gestão de Negócios, Energia ou Transformação Digital.
  • Tiver certificações em Product Ownership (CSPO, PSPO) e metodologias ágeis (CSM, SAFe).
  • Tiver familiaridade com o setor de gás e energia, incluindo regulação da ANP e processos como medição, faturamento, logística e segurança operacional.
  • Demonstrar forte visão sistêmica e pensamento crítico.
  • Apresentar habilidade de negociação e influência.
  • Ser resiliente e adaptável em ambientes de alta complexidade.
  • Ter perfil colaborativo e facilitador.

  • Possuir experiência em contextos dinâmicos.

title: Landholder And Reforestation Delivery Manager
description:
About NatureCo NatureCo delivers nature-based solutions (NbS) for investors, corporates and other purpose driven organisations to scale up action on climate change and biodiversity loss. We specialise in nature-based project development including reforestation, agroforestry, farmer managed natural regeneration and mangrove restoration. NatureCo has extensive expertise in working with local communities to protect and restore natural ecosystems through participation in the global voluntary carbon market. NatureCo is currently implementing a large-scale reforestation project in Brazil for the generation of verified carbon credits. We are a diverse, mission-driven team that values inclusion, integrity, and innovation. NatureCo is proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer, committed to building an equitable and inclusive workplace for all.Role and responsibilities The Landholder and Reforestation Delivery Manager is the primary field-based interface with landholders, communities, reforestation contractors, and other local stakeholders for NatureCo's projects in Brazil. This position will build and manage a pipeline of landholders interested in reforestation, lead outreach and onboarding, coordinate site inspections, lead the collection of relevant data required for carbon standard checks, and lead signature of landholder agreements. The role will also play a key role in ensuring compliance (contracts and carbon standards) as well as coordinate schedules between landholders and contractors for the implementation of reforestation activities. This will include confirming site readiness, conducting periodic field quality audits, documenting and tracking progress, and resolving issues that could delay delivery or degrade quality. The role requires a strong combination stakeholder engagement and management experience, and a commitment to quality and impact. The role requires extensive travel and field work across Minas Gerais, Bahia and Espírito Santo.Primary roles and responsibilities include: Landholder engagement, onboarding, and pipeline management Map priority municipalities and referral partner networks (city governments, co-ops, farmer associations, NGOs);
plan and run outreach activities, events and information sessions. Manage the landholder onboarding process (identify → qualify → onboard → contract), using CRM/trackers to keep status, documents and next actions current. Prepare clear information packs (benefits, obligations, timelines) and respond to inquiries in a timely, professional manner. Maintain ongoing landholder relationship management to support retention, satisfaction, and smooth site access throughout implementation. Eligibility, due diligence & agreements Coordinate site inspections and initial diagnostics in consultation with other team members (parcel boundaries, vegetation status, access, water, risks). Support land tenure verification and FPIC documentation Lead closure of contract signatures. Maintain organized repository of all landholder records within NatureCo's data management system (land titles, eligibility documents, contracts, site maps, inspection notes, photos, consultation records). Reforestation delivery enablement Translate signed landholder agreements into implementation-ready site plans (site-specific scope, access instructions, constraints, schedule windows). Align field schedules with landholders and contractors to ensure access, minimize disruption to farm activities, and maintain trust and cooperation. Support in the delivery of field delivery progress from contractors by site (start/finish dates, activities completed, challenges, next steps), and escalate issues early (access, weather delays, input shortages, labor constraints). Support in monitoring reforestation activities (during and post planting) and coordinate, where required, rapid response with contractors/landholders (grazing, fire risk, pests, drought stress). Stakeholder engagement and safeguards Plan and document stakeholder consultations and community meetings in accordance with NatureCo policies and procedures (agendas, attendance lists, minutes, photos). Support the team in the operation of the grievance mechanism: receiving grievances and responding in accordance with the NatureCo grievance mechanism. Maintain landholder contact and ensure landholder information is kept up to date. Coordinate access, for other project staff and contractors as required. Reporting Lead or assist the development of formal monthly, quarterly, and annual project implementation reports for internal and external stakeholders in line with contract and/or carbon standard requirements. Prepare ad hoc reports, documents, and presentations for internal and external stakeholders. Teamwork and culture Support the management of a cross-functional, international team, fostering collaboration and ensuring that project milestones and goals are met. Stay current on emerging best practices in NbS and carbon projects;
proactively share insights across the organisation and with partners.Skills and attributes To perform successfully in this role, you will have: A minimum of five (5) years of experience in reforestation projects with direct contact with rural landholders and reforestation planting service providers. Degree in forest engineering, agronomy, ecology, or environmental science. Intermediate English and native Portuguese language skills Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to engage confidently across cultures and stakeholder groups. Strong project management skills, including experience managing timelines, deliverables, and working across multidisciplinary teams. A proactive, self-starting approach with the ability to anticipate problems, adapt quickly, and take initiative under limited supervision. A collaborative mindset and ability to lead and motivate internal teams and external partners Ability to provide strategic and technical guidance across complex, multi-stakeholder projects. Strong organisational skills and attention to detail in documentation and reporting. A positive, energetic personality with resilience and drive to see projects through to delivery.Extensive travel within Brazil is a requirement to perform this position.Location Remote, with residence in Minas Gerais, Espirito Santo, or BahiaSubmission instructions Email CV and brief cover letter towith subject: Landholder and Reforestation Delivery Manager Submission deadline: 30 March 2026

title: Senior Web Manager
description: About the Role: We are looking for a visionary Senior Web Manager to lead the transformation of our marketing website into a high-performing, modern digital engine. In this role, you will be the primary owner of our marketing website, sisense.Com, responsible for everything from day-to-day maintenance to leading strategic initiatives that streamline the back-end experience for our marketing team. You will be a key driver in evolving our current WordPress platform into a more efficient, scalable system. We are looking for a candidate who is not only a WordPress expert but also brings experience with modern web systems like Webflow or Contentful to help guide our long-term digital roadmap.Key Responsibilities: Strategic Web Leadership: Own the overarching strategic vision for web projects, including design, development, and optimization efforts that support annual marketing goals. Custom Development & Design: Go beyond basic management to create custom web pages and reusable components that enhance our site's flexibility and user experience. Back-End Transformation: Lead the evolution of our website's back-end to create a more streamlined, user-friendly experience for internal marketing content creators. Platform Management: Oversee the functionality and performance of our current WordPress platform while evaluating and potentially integrating new tools like Webflow or Contentful. Performance & Optimization: Monitor and report on key metrics (traffic, conversion rates, SEO, page speed) and execute A/B tests to drive continuous improvement. Cross-Functional Collaboration: Partner with Demand Gen, Product Marketing, Brand, and IT teams to ensure the website accurately represents our brand and delivers qualified leads. Vendor & Technical Management: Manage relationships with external agencies and developers, ensuring projects are delivered on time and within scope.What We're Looking For: Experience: 5–8+ years in web management or digital strategy, ideally within a high-growth B2B SaaS environment. Technical Proficiency: Deep expertise in WordPress (current platform of record) is required. Strong preference for candidates with hands-on experience in Webflow or Contentful. Frontend Skills: Proficiency in HTML, CSS, and JavaScript to build and troubleshoot custom web components. SEO & Analytics: Advanced knowledge of technical SEO principles and web analytics tools like GA4 and Google Tag Manager. Project Management: Proven ability to manage complex website redesigns or migrations from strategy through execution. Mindset: A data-driven, self-starter who can translate complex technical concepts for non-technical stakeholders and is passionate about building a best-in-class digital experience.Why Join Us: This is a high-impact role where you will have the autonomy to shape our digital future. You'll be part of a team that values innovation, out-of-the-box thinking, and creating exceptional customer experiences.

Client is seeking a senior-level Workday Adaptive Planning Consultant to lead the architecture, design, and build of complex planning solutions. title: Cx Ai & Knowledge Manager (Remote/Brazil)
description:
About us

Carepod is a growing e-commerce brand focused on delivering a great customer experience at every step. We believe support should be fast, accurate, human, and scalable. We use AI to help our team work smarter, but we still care deeply about quality, clarity, and trust.

About the role

We are hiring a CX AI & Knowledge Manager to own the systems behind great support.

This person will manage our customer-facing knowledge, train and improve Gorgias AI, review and QA AI responses, keep our FAQ and help center up to date, and help train our team on the right processes and information.

You will be the person making sure our customers get accurate answers, our AI gets smarter over time, and our support team has the tools and guidance they need to do great work.

What you'll own
  • Own and maintain the source of truth for support knowledge, product information, policies, and FAQs
  • Train, test, and improve Gorgias AI so responses are accurate, helpful, and on-brand
  • Review AI-generated customer responses and build a QA process to catch issues early
  • Update help center articles, FAQs, macros, and internal SOPs as products and policies change
  • Work with CX, product, operations, and marketing teams to keep information consistent across channels
  • Help onboard and train support team members on tools, workflows, and knowledge resources
  • Identify repeated support issues and fix the root cause through better documentation, automation, or training
  • Track key metrics tied to AI quality, knowledge coverage, support accuracy, and team enablement
What success looks like in the first 90 days
  • Audit our current help center, macros, and Gorgias AI setup
  • Clean up the biggest knowledge gaps affecting customers and support agents
  • Improve AI response quality for our most common support questions
  • Launch a simple QA process for AI responses
  • Create a repeatable system for updating customer-facing and internal knowledge when the business changes
  • Make it easier for team members to find the right answer fast
What we're looking for
  • 3+ years in customer experience, CX operations, knowledge management, support enablement, or a similar role
  • Hands-on experience with Gorgias, Zendesk, Intercom, or another support platform
  • Strong writing and editing skills
  • Experience building or maintaining a help center, FAQ library, or internal knowledge base
  • Comfortable reviewing support conversations and turning patterns into process improvements
  • Strong project management and cross-functional communication skills
  • Highly organized, detail-oriented, and able to turn messy information into clear guidance
  • Able to train people, not just tools
Bonus points
  • Experience in e-commerce, especially Shopify brands
  • Experience with AI support tools, automation, and QA workflows
  • Experience writing SOPs, training materials, or internal playbooks
  • Familiarity with product catalogs, product information, or merchandising workflows
Why this role matters

This role sits at the center of customer truth. When done well, it improves customer trust, reduces mistakes, helps the support team move faster, and makes AI genuinely useful.

How to apply

Please apply with your resume and a short note answering these 3 questions:

  • Tell us about a knowledge base, FAQ, or support system you improved.
  • Tell us about a time you trained or improved an AI or automation workflow.
  • How would you keep product information accurate across multiple teams?

About the Product For more than 30 years,Carnegiehas been a leader and innovator in higher education marketing and enrollment strategy, offering groundbreaking services in the areas of Research, Strategy, Digital Marketing, Lead Generation, Slate Optimization, Student Search, Website Development, and Creative that generate authentic connections.Role Overview We are seeking an expert-level, highly skilledCloud Systems Engineer (DevOps)to serve as aGCP Specialist and technical builderfor our Google Cloud ecosystem. This role requires more than administration;
you must be capable ofbuilding architectural change, adjusting systems, and driving modernization efforts.You will be responsible for the end-to-end management of our GCP infrastructure, from complex networking to proactive cost optimization and resource scaling. A key responsibility isleading and running large-scale cloud migration projects, specifically from AWS to GCP.The ideal candidate ensures ourCompute Engineenvironment is lean, fast, and resilient while maintaining secure connectivity using both native and third-party VPN solutions. The role's primary focus demands deep GCP expertise, but candidates must also possess significant experience with AWS for successful migration strategy.Key Responsibilities Infrastructure & Networking:Configure and maintain robust networking architectures, includingCloud DNSandCloud NAT. Linux System Administration:Manage and maintain the operating system environment on Compute Engine instances, including patching, configuration management, user account management, and troubleshooting core system issues. VPN Management:Build and manage secure tunnels usingCloud VPN ,pfSensevirtual appliances, andCloudConnexa(OpenVPN) for flexible remote access. Performance Monitoring:Utilize Google Cloud Operations Suite to monitorCompute Enginehealth. Identify bottlenecks and tune instances for peak performance. Resource Management:Oversee persistent disks, snapshots, and storage buckets. Ensure high availability while purging unused resources to maintain environment hygiene. Cost Optimization:Actively monitor billing dashboards, implement committed use discounts (CUDs), and right-size underutilized instances to maintain a lean budget. Database Oversight:Provide support forPostgreSQLandOracleenvironments, ensuring seamless integration and performance within the GCP ecosystem. Security & Compliance : Enforce IAM roles and security best practices to protect the project perimeterRequired Qualifications Certification:ActiveGoogle Cloud Professional DevOps Engineercertification. Containerization Mastery:Strong expertise withDockerfor containerizing applications, managing images, and troubleshooting container runtimes. Scripting Mastery:High proficiency inPythonorBashfor automating routine infrastructure tasks, reporting, and task scheduling. Networking Expertise:Hands-on experience managing network routing, firewall rules, and site-to-site VPNs usingpfSenseandCloudConnexa. Cloud Migration & Project Leadership:Proven experienceleading and runningapplication and data migrations fromAWStoGCP.This includes the capability toown the end-to-end migration project life cycle and drive solutions. Compute Engine Mastery:Deep understanding of VM lifecycles, custom machine types, and auto-scaling. English Proficiency:Advanced English level (B2–C1 or higher)Nice-to-Have PostgreSQL Expertise:Strong hands-on experience with configuration, optimization, and query tuning. Oracle Expertise:Experience managing or migrating Oracle database environments. Data & Analytics:Familiarity withBigQuery.We offer We welcome new ideas and allow you to make an immediate impact on the team. Flexible Paid time off (PTO for any reason, including sick days (no specified limits) and flexible work schedule). Personal laptop. Health and wellness package. Fully remote.As this is an English-speaking role, we kindly ask that all applications be submitted with a CV in English.

title: Clinical Study Manager
description: Job Summary The Clinical Study Manager (CSM) will be part of the Clinical Operations Department, which is responsible for planning, executing, managing and closing studies associated with the company clinical development plans. The CSM is a proven leader in clinical development with study management experience in the pharmaceutical or device industry. The CSM provides leadership and support to members of the multidisciplinary program teams, internally and externally, and can successfully thrive in a virtual clinical model. The CSM reports to the Senior Director of Clinical Operations and may be based at Liquidia's headquarters in Research Triangle Park, North Carolina, or remote.Specific Duties, Activities, and Responsibilities Act as a patient advocate throughout the clinical development project lifecycle, with a mindset to minimize patient and site burden when participating in clinical trials. Understand and support trial milestones including site identification and assessment, patient/subject recruitment, Key Opinion Leader (KOL) and Steering Committee development, and medical affairs support as required. Coordinate internally with Medical and Quality Assurance to identify risks to clinical trial projects. Participates in the development of study timelines, in coordination with the internal study team and external partners. Manages the trial according to agreed timelines. Develop Requests for Proposals for vendors (CRO, Bioanalytical Labs, Central Safety Labs, Data Management groups, etc.) required to support clinical studies. Assist or lead the vetting of vendors and sites for study participation. In collaboration with Program Leaders, lead the development and updates of study specific protocols, consent forms, and other trial related materials (e.G., Study Monitoring Plan, Data Management Plans, CRFs, site training materials, Advertising Materials, etc.) as required. Oversee the work of CROs and other vendors (Central Labs, Clinical Supply Distributors, etc.) as assigned to clinical trials. Identifies potential risks to timelines, budgets, and quality, and participates in establishing and overseeing mitigation strategies with the internal team members and external partners, as applicable. Manage and track clinical trial budgets to include forecasting, review, and approval of vendor and site payments. The CSM is also responsible for notifying management of anticipated change orders and/or budget adjustments proactively Assumes primary accountability for assigned clinical trial execution according to protocol requirements, trial plans, company SOPs, ICH-GCP, FDA regulations, and applicable regulations in other regions. Collaboratively work with the project team and other CRO/vendor resources and timelines associated with all study activities, including CRO/investigator agreements, central IRBs, database development and maintenance, monitoring strategy, QA audit plan, and coordination of Clinical Safety Review Teams when applicable. Supports material planning and management to ensure appropriate execution of the clinical projects, including but not limited to distribution of documents, forms, supplies, equipment, and investigational product. Reviews reports from study data systems which show progress of data collection, source document verification, and query resolution. Reports untimely data entry to Program lead. Collaborates with Program Lead and medical monitor to ensure adverse event review and coding review occur on the timelines detailed in study plans. Assists with review of study data reports during the cleaning phase of a study (i.E. prior to interim analysis or database lock) and aligns with team on any issues needing escalation. Ensure the Trial Master File (TMF) is maintained and up to date and all documents are accounted for by completion of clinical study report. Generate compelling periodic trial Newsletters to communicate important trial aspects to trial sites. Ensure the development and maintenance of trial-specific tracking systems to enable proper study management and monitoring activities, as required Work with the Senior Director of Clinical Operations, or similar to ensure that internal program team members are trained appropriately on study conduct Serve as a liaison between external partners and internal team to ensure program specific information and ongoing updates are proactively communicated Participates in the development, review, and implementation of departmental SOPs, processes, and initiatives. Attend off-site meetings and conferences, as needed. Mentorship of junior colleagues in Clinical Operations and other departments in areas of oversight to foster development and expansion of junior colleague skill sets.Education and Experience Bachelors with a minimum of five years of experience in clinical research, with at least two years of clinical project/study management. Experience qualifying & managing external vendors (e.G. CRO, Call Center, Central labs, etc.). Experience managing clinical project team personnel. Experience leading operational teams through the start-up, study conduct, data management, and report writing of clinical studies. Experience liaising cross-functional teams internally and with external partners to align on program expectations. Experience reviewing and editing protocols and clinical study reports. Demonstrates knowledge of Good Clinical Practices and all applicable US regulations governing clinical research, as well as working knowledge of the FDA submission process. Experience in Global clinical studies and country/region specific regulations governing clinical research outside of the US. Excellent organization and communication skills, including experience dealing with decision makers such as physicians and IRB members. Demonstrates problem-solving and interpersonal skills.Must have a 'can-do' attitude and a strong desire to take ownership of many different projects. Ability to work independently and manage multiple timelines, while maintaining the team focus. Demonstrated ability to exercise judgment and determine appropriate action to a variety of problems of varying complexity. Demonstrated ability to manage multiple deadlines.Knowledge, Skills and Abilities Strong desire to join a small company and work in a fast-paced environment. Ability to work with remote teams and to negotiate with external providers. Must be detail oriented, highly organized, reliable, and accurate. Must be a motivated self-starter, adaptable, and capable of working within a matrix environment. Must display sound judgment and discretion as well as problem solving abilities especially within a team environment. Experience with tools and systems for managing clinical rials (CTMS, TMF, EDC, ePRO database, Microsoft suite, etc.).. Compelling interpersonal verbal, written and presentation skills in communication with internal and external customers. Must have the ability to accommodate international and domestic travel up to 30% at the request of the business. Must be fluent in English

title: Lead Generation Specialist

This role requires strong communication skills, exceptional organization, and the ability to work independently across multiple systems while maintaining high response rates and booking quality.Responsibilities Monitor and respond to new leads across all platforms (GHL, Leadhype, Smartlead, Meta ads). Conduct daily call show audits and update show/no-show statuses in tracking systems. Manage and update the Airtable Lead Gen dashboard with accurate lead data and metrics. Qualify inbound leads and schedule sales calls with interested prospects. Execute manual follow-ups for warm leads and re-engagement campaigns. Maintain accurate pipeline management and ensure all conversations are properly categorized. Coordinate reschedules for no-show prospects and maintain consistent follow-up cadence. title: Information Technology Manager
description:
Role Overview

Syntage is seeking an IT & Automation Manager to serve as the technical owner of our internal systems, IT infrastructure, and process automations. This role bridges the gap between business operations and technology. You will act as an internal consultant outlining high-level technical strategies, while also personally executing the hands-on development—including software integrations, AI adoption, and workflow automations. Additionally, you will manage the company's foundational cybersecurity posture and day-to-day IT administration.

Key Responsibilities

Business Process Engineering (Core Expectation)

  • Conduct needs assessments with department leads to identify operational bottlenecks and manual processes.
  • Translate non-technical business requirements into actionable architectural designs and technical scopes.
  • Act as an internal consultant, proposing ROI-driven technology implementations.
  • Manage change adoption by providing training, documentation, and ongoing support for newly implemented tools.

Automation, Integration & AI Implementation

  • Design, build, and maintain system integrations across our SaaS ecosystem utilizing REST APIs, webhooks, and middleware platforms (e.G., Zapier, Make, n8n) or custom scripts (Python, JavaScript).
  • Evaluate, test, and deploy AI tools to automate routine operational tasks.
  • Administer databases and ensure data integrity as information flows between the CRM, ERP, and operational software.

IT Administration & Security

  • Administer core software platforms and directories, including (Google Workspace / Microsoft 365).
  • Manage the employee technology lifecycle, including hardware provisioning and onboarding/offboarding technical access.
  • Enforce cybersecurity best practices, managing Identity and Access Management (IAM), SSO, MFA, and endpoint security.
  • Manage IT vendor relationships, negotiate SaaS contracts, and monitor software spend to systematically prevent tool sprawl.

Required Qualifications & Skills

Technical Experience:

  • 5+ years of hybrid experience spanning IT Administration, Systems Architecture, Technical Operations, Business Process Engineering, or Software Integration.
  • Demonstrated experience managing technology projects end-to-end within an SMB or startup environment.
  • Strong understanding of cloud-based SaaS ecosystems, APIs, and relational data structures.
  • High proficiency in building complex workflows using middleware (e.G., n8n, Make, Zapier) or lightweight scripting.
  • Practical knowledge of applying AI tools to everyday business workflows.
  • Foundational understanding of cybersecurity risk management, network security, and data privacy protocols.

Soft Skills & Behavioral Competencies:

  • Communication: Proven ability to effectively translate business needs into technical scopes, and explain complex technical concepts and security requirements to non-technical stakeholders with patience and clarity.
  • Critical Thinking: Strong analytical approach to problem-solving;
    ability to identify theroot causes of operational friction rather than just treating symptoms.
  • Decision-Making: Highly autonomous execution;
    capable of evaluating vendor tools, technical trade-offs, and ROI to make definitive architectural and software purchasing decisions.

Benefits & Compensation

  • Compensation details will be discussed during the interview process.

Jornada de Formação – Assessor(a) de Investimentos EQI

A jornada é estruturada para acelerar o desenvolvimento técnico, comercial e estratégico do profissional, que desde o primeiro dia já atua como Assessor(a) de Investimentos EQI.

  • 1º mês | Onboarding

  • 2º mês | Prospecção

  • 3º e 4º meses | Aquisição
  • Fase de maior autonomia na condução do ciclo comercial. O assessor passa a realizar reuniões, captar recursos e estruturar as primeiras carteiras, desenvolvendo capacidade de negociação, relacionamento e fechamento de negócios.
  • Meses seguintes | Alocação e Consolidação
  • Momento de fortalecimento e expansão da carteira, com definição de estratégias de investimento, adequação de produtos ao perfil do cliente e aprofundamento do relacionamento de longo prazo.
  • Ao longo de toda a jornada, o profissional conta com simulações comerciais com apoio de IA, suporte técnico especializado e fornecimento de leads para impulsionar o crescimento.
  • Evolução
  • Após a conclusão da formação, permanece como Assessor(a) de Investimentos EQI, agora com maior domínio técnico, autonomia ampliada e atuação mais estratégica com plano de carreira estruturado com 12 Níveis de desenvolvimento.

title: Especialista De Conteúdo
description: ESPECIALISTA DE CONTEÚDO 100% remoto Remuneração competitiva, alinhada à experiência e ao nível de contribuição Autonomia real para construir, testar e escalar Cultura direta, colaborativa e orientada à responsabilidade, execução e crescimentoSOBRE A ADAFLOW A Adaflow nasceu para simplificar a vida de quem presta serviços no Brasil ou no exterior.Ajudamos profissionais e empresas a abrir CNPJ, emitir notas fiscais e cuidar da rotina contábil, sem perder horas com a prefeitura, cartórios, sistemas confusos e burocracias que tiram energia de quem deveria estar focado em crescer.Combinamos tecnologia, automação e atendimento humano para transformar a contabilidade em uma experiência simples, segura e eficiente.Conheça mais em:  agora a gente precisa de alguém que faça com que o conteúdo transmita essa mesma mensagem.O QUE VOCÊ VAI FAZER Você vai ser dono(a) do conteúdo da Adaflow. Ponto. Não é executar briefings dos outros, é construir e rodar a estratégia com autonomia real. Na prática, isso significa: Estratégia e produção de conteúdo orgânico — definir pauta, produzir e distribuir conteúdo para blog, newsletter e redes sociais (LinkedIn, Instagram e o que mais fizer sentido). Cada peça precisa ter uma tese clara, um objetivo definido e uma métrica de sucesso. Conteúdo SEO-driven que converte intenção em tráfego — produzir conteúdo estratégico para blog e páginas, focado em transformar a intenção de busca em tráfego qualificado. Pesquisa de palavras-chave e otimização on-page — desenvolver pautas com base em keyword research, estruturar heading tags com hierarquia clara, otimizar meta-tags, title, description e a estrutura de URL. IA como parte do processo — usar ferramentas de IA para escalar pesquisa, primeiras versões, variações e distribuição. Você decide onde a IA entra e sai, mantendo a qualidade editorial no padrão da marca. Régua de comunicação com clientes — desenhar e operar a comunicação recorrente com a base: e-mail marketing, avisos de obrigações fiscais, atualizações de produto, comunicados importantes. Cadência, segmentação e copy são suas responsabilidades. Apoio direto às vendas e ao marketing — produzir LPs, VSLs e fluxos de ativação junto com Growth. Gestão dos próprios projetos — você organiza prazo, escopo e prioridade no Notion/ClickUp, comunica status sem precisar ser cobrada(o) e entrega com contexto. Guardiã(o) do tom de voz e do posicionamento — garantir que tudo o que sai da Adaflow soe como Adaflow, em qualquer canal. Você define guidelines, revisa o que outras áreas publicam quando faz sentido e protege a consistência da marca. Colaboração real com Branding e Growth — o modelo de gestão compartilhada significa que você participa das decisões estratégicas, traz dados e perspectiva editorial. O problema do time é também seu problema.O QUE A GENTE PROCURA Experiência sólida em conteúdo digital, de ponta a ponta: blog, newsletter e mídias. Curiosidade ativa com IA aplicada à criação de conteúdo: você testa novas ferramentas por conta própria, tem opinião sobre quais usar e pra quê, e está sempre experimentando o que acabou de sair. Repertório de ferramentas é parte do jogo. O stack que essa cadeira costuma rodar passa por: IA e automação de conteúdo (Automarticles, Greatapps, Lovable, Typebot), gestão de projetos (Notion, ClickUp), design (Figma, Canva), SEO (Ahrefs, SEMrush, Surfer), newsletter e e-mail (Substack, Beehiiv, Mailchimp, RD Station), social (Metricool, Buffer) e análise (GA4, Hotjar). Não precisa ter rodado todas, precisa ter repertório e saber escolher a ferramenta certa pro problema certo. Escrita excelente, com repertório para transitar entre formatos e tons sem perder a voz da marca. Capacidade de tocar projeto sozinho(a). Visão analítica: você precisa considerar CAC, engajamento, tráfego orgânico e conversão como parte do seu trabalho. Comunicação direta, pública e clara.DIFERENCIAIS Automação de marketing e CRM. Vivência em startup ou scale-up de ritmo acelerado, você sabe o que é prazo apertado e prioridade que muda.NEM TODO MUNDO FOI FEITO PARA ESSE RITMO Se você quer um lugar onde alguém te diz exatamente o que escrever, precisa de reuniões intermináveis para tomar decisões ou prefere distribuir responsabilidade do que ser dono do resultado, existem boas empresas pra isso. Essa não é uma delas.Mas se você quer construir a comunicação de uma empresa de tecnologia que está reinventando a contabilidade do Brasil, com automação de ponta, evoluir com gente que coloca a régua pra cima e ter ownership real do que produz, então queremos conhecer você!Inscreva-se pelo formulário:

title: Ai Development Orchestrator
description:
Location:Remote Type:Full-Time Reports to:CEO Stack:TypeScript, Python, React (Next.Js App Router), Node, PostgreSQL, Supabase (Auth + RLS + Edge Functions + Realtime + Storage), Tailwind, shadcn/ui, Anthropic SDK, MCP, Bash, Git Stage: Revenue-generating SaaS, active production users Start:ImmediateThe Company Fabri Holdings is a dynamic and forward-thinking company that values innovative solutions and creativity. With a commitment to excellence and collaboration, the company provides comprehensive services tailored to the needs of its diverse clientele. Fabri Holdings fosters an inclusive and supportive work culture, encouraging employees to achieve their full potential. We are currently hiring for a partner company that is the operating system for founders building personal brands. They help B2B founders turn expertise into organic content engines that generate revenue without ads, agencies, or 10-hour content days. They have served 18,000+ founders and built a $15M/year business on organic content alone. They are now building the platform that powers our done-for-you delivery at scale.The Role You are the engineering quality gate. You direct AI agents through focused task briefs, review every commit, and catch what the AI misses. You think in systems;
the agents think in code. Multiple LLMs are run against the same problem;
the strongest output isselected. Your job is to ensure what ships is correct, secure, performant, and architecturally sound. Every uncertain decision goes through structured review before approval. The validation layer is non-negotiable.What You Do Review every AI-generated commit. Not "does it run" - "what happens under concurrent load, what happens when an edge function cold-starts, what RLS policy is silently leaking across tenants." Architect features as single-task agent briefs: What / Why / Done When / Watch Out For. Scoped, focused, clear. Own the test pipeline. Vitest unit + Deno tests for edge functions + Playwright E2E. Evaluate whether tests prove behavior or inflate coverage. Diagnose, the agents fix, you verify. Refactor when AI-generated code drifts. Keep the codebase coherent. Own production stability. Read Supabase logs, trace edge functions through RLS, identify root cause, direct the fix. Scale architecture for 10x growth without rewrites.Must-Haves Daily production AI workflow. You ship features where AI wrote the code and you validated it. Not autocomplete. Not casual. Multi-agent, multi-model, structured review. You are the reviewer;
the AI is the author. Supabase in production. PostgreSQL with RLS, Auth (email + magic link + OAuth), Edge Functions (Deno), Realtime, Storage. You have been burned by race conditions and you know how to write RLS that is both secure AND performant. TypeScript primary. Strict mode. Zod at system boundaries. You understand why compile-time types and runtime validation are different problems. React in production. Next.Js App Router, server components, complex state, real-time UIs, large component libraries (shadcn/ui or equivalent). You understand re-renders, memoization, and bundle size as engineering concerns. Python comfort. Our sync engines and integration scripts are Python. You can read, debug, and ship in it. Third-party API integration in production. Stripe, HubSpot, Calendly, Fathom, social APIs. Webhook verification, idempotency, retries, graceful degradation when an upstream is down. Edge function fluency. Deno or equivalent serverless. Cold starts, execution limits, no in-memory state across invocations. Code review depth. You catch security holes, race conditions, tests that pass without testing, RLS that leaks, cache that serves stale data after mutation. This is 60% of the role.Strong Signals Built or customized AI agent workflows: Claude Code skills, CLAUDE.Md configurations, memory persistence, multi-model comparison. Reviewed AI-generated PRs (not AI-assisted human code). Database-level access control in production. Real-time features: Supabase Realtime or WebSockets, with subscription lifecycle and reconnection handling. OWASP Top 10 fluency. Product SaaS background, not agency or consultancy.Red Flags AI is autocomplete or boilerplate to you. Cannot explain architectural decisions in code shipped with AI assistance. Treats AI as infallible OR untrustworthy. Right stance: trust but verify. Overrides correct AI output on gut feel instead of validated review. Frontend-only or backend-only specialist. The review surface is full-stack. Consulting/body-shop background with no production ownership. No experience with real-time, data-heavy applications.Who This Person Is 3 to 7 years full-stack, weighted toward TypeScript + Supabase (or equivalent PostgreSQL stack) and Python comfort. Not a 15-year veteran - we need someone agile and AI-native, not resistant. You understand a production system end-to-end: frontend, edge functions, database, auth, third-party integrations. You don't need to be the deepest expert in every layer. You need enough depth across all of them to catch when AI generates something architecturally wrong, and enough humility to validate before approving.How We Evaluate No 60-minute coding test. We evaluate thinking, reviewing, directing. Bug Triage. Real (sanitized) bug from our codebase. Walk us through diagnosis. Do you read the code? Ask the right questions? Understand what could go wrong beyond the immediate symptom? Cold Code Review. Unaudited file written by an AI agent. Tell us what you see: security, race conditions, RLS leak, stale cache, tests that pass without proving anything. Task Brief. We hand you a feature requirement. Write the brief you'd give an AI agent. Is it clear, scoped, and likely to produce good first-pass output? AI Workflow Conversation. Describe your current AI workflow in detail. What you trust, what you double-check, how you handle uncertainty.What We Offer A founding-level seat. Your judgment shapes the product. Direct CEO access. The most advanced AI development workflow you'll work in: multi-model agent orchestration, AI-generated codebase, structured validation, Claude Code skills + memory. Production impact day one. The product is live. Founders use it daily. Your work ships immediately. A product founders love: 18,000+ served, $15M/year, organic-only. A process that values getting it right. Speed comes from AI;
quality comes from you.To Apply or Refer Send a brief note describing your AI coding workflow and a link to something you've shipped. Include your React + TypeScript + Supabase (or equivalent) experience. No cover letter. We read code and we read people.

We are seeking a Senior Software Engineer contractor to join our U.S.-based team remotely. You will leverage your technical expertise to deliver high-quality code for moderately to highly complex projects.

In this role, you will work on our healthcare platform, gaining deep system knowledge and contributing to our Agile workflow via Azure DevOps. Key Responsibilities

3. Peer Reviews & Post-Release Support

  • Participate in pre-release feature reviews (ongoing).
  • Conduct initial post-release bug ticket analysis (first 90 days), transitioning to broader ownership over time.

4. Agile Collaboration

  • Actively contribute to 2-week sprints and 6-week release cycles (3 sprints per release).
  • Participate in sprint planning, pull requests, releases, and daily stand-ups (3:00 PM CT).

5. Communication & Coordination

  • Collaborate effectively with technical and non-technical team members across time zones.

Qualifications

Experience

  • 8 years of software engineering experience, with a proven track record on complex projects.

Technical Skills

  • Proficiency in C# ASP.NET (.NET 8) for web applications and APIs.
  • Experience with .NET MAUI and Blazor Web Application (.NET 8) for mobile and web development.
  • Familiarity with Microsoft Azure (Azure App Service, Azure SQL, Azure Storage).
  • Proficient with modern development tools (Visual Studio, Git, Azure DevOps).
  • Knowledge of secure coding practices and cybersecurity principles.
  • Experience with cloud platforms and Agile methodologies.

Soft Skills

  • Excellent problem-solving and analytical abilities.
  • Strong communication skills for remote collaboration.
  • Ability to work independently and within a collaborative team.

Preferred

  • Familiarity with healthcare software or Protected Health Information standards (e.G., HIPAA).
  • Experience with pull request reviews and sprint participation.

How We Work

  • Agile Workflow: 2-week sprints, 6-week release cycles, daily stand-ups at 3:00 PM CT.
  • Code Standards: Strict adherence to best practices, peer reviews, and security testing (e.G., OWASP, Detectify).
  • Tools: Azure DevOps, Visual Studio, SQL Server Management Studio, Datadog, Microsoft Playwright, and more.
  • Team Culture: Accountability, quality, and excellence in delivery.

You will design the interfaces that allow thousands of employees to interact with\ "agentic\" workflows, turningcomplex supply chain logic into intuitive, guided digital experiences. What You Will Do ●Product & Interface Strategy:Architect the user journey for complex, end-to-end internal applications. You will take ownership of the UX for major platform features, ensuring they are intuitive and resilient to user error. ●Frontend-Aligned Design:Design responsive, highly interactive, and accessible UIs. You will work closely with engineers to ensure designs account for complex global states and performance optimization. ●Information Architecture:Design robust flows for procurement data. You will architect how users navigate high-density enterprise information, making it scannable and actionable. ●AI Interaction Design (AWS Bedrock Integration):Design the\ "Human-in-the-Loop\" patternsfor our AI features. You will create the UI that helps users trust and verify AI-generated procurement suggestions and RAG-driven insights. ●Systems Thinking:Maintain and evolve our internal design system. You will ensure that AI-assisted workflows feel like a natural, cohesive extension of the Rivian digital ecosystem. ●AI-Assisted Design:Utilize modern AI design tools to accelerate the generation of variants and assets, while focusing your human effort on high-level UX strategy, user research, and complex problem-solving.Requirements & Tooling ●Design Tools:Mastery ofFigma, including advanced prototyping and design system management. ●Frontend Literacy:A deep understanding ofReact/TypeScriptcapabilities so your designs are technically feasible and\ "developer-ready.\" ●AI UX Frameworks:Experience designing for LLM interactions (handling latency, showing AI\ "thought processes,\" and providing feedback loops). ●Prototyping:Proficiency in tools like Protopie, Framer, or high-fidelity Figma prototyping to demonstrate multi-step agentic logic. ●Testing:Experience collaborating on usability testing and using feedback to iterate on complex enterprise tools.What We're Looking For ●Experience:Product Design, specifically within B2B SaaS, Fintech, or complex internal enterprise tools. ●Architecture Focus:You possess the ability to simplify massive data sets and multi-step manual processes into clean, automated paths. ●Collaborative Mindset:You work seamlessly with engineers, understanding that the best designs are those that are safely and effectively deployed. ●Language Requirements:Advanced English and Portuguese proficiency for daily communicationIgualdade & Oportunidade para Todos Representando 165 nacionalidades em todo o mundo, nos orgulhamos de ser um empregador que oferece igualdade de oportunidades, comprometido em fornecer oportunidades iguais de emprego a todos os candidatos e funcionários, independentemente de raça, religião, sexo, cor, idade, nacionalidade, gravidez, orientação sexual, deficiência física ou informações genéticas, ou qualquer outra classificação protegida, de acordo com as leis federais, estaduais e/ou locais.
